newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK and Shanghai Bank raises best lending rate.
newsitem.headline: HK and Shanghai Bank raises best lending rate.

text.p: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it would raise its best lending rate by 25 basis points to 8.75 percent with effect from Thursday.

"Our decision to raise interest rates reflects the Hong Kong Association of Banks' rise in the savings rate, following the latest rate increase in the United States," Chris Langley, general manager, Hong Kong and China, said in a statement.
"This move is unlikely to adversely affect Hong Kong's economy as it has been fully factored in by the markets.
"It may in fact prove mildly beneficial by helping to moderate inflationary pressure and excessive increase in property prices," he added.
The rate has remained unchanged since February 2, 1996, when it reduced it by 25 basis points.
